Price is $4286.2, -11.8 (-0.27%) compared with yesterday's close of 4298.0.
Current read: LEAN BULLISH. Gold is leaning slightly UP. Because it's -0.27% compared with where it finished yesterday, and in the last hour it's been going up (+0.00%), and today's headlines lean good for gold (2 good vs 0 bad).
Today's range: low $4244.4 to high $4315.8. Price is 59% of the way up that range ($41.8 above the low, $29.6 below the high).
Trading sessions open right now: New York. Next: New York closes in 243 minutes.
Measured from the last two days of 1-minute data, gold moves most in these hours (SGT): 00:00 (3.9 pips/min), 22:00 (3.3 pips/min), 20:00 (3.2 pips/min).
